items.summary: CRO disposition: reject the proposed fleet work-admission control-plane build this cycle. It duplicates existing control-plane coverage, while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, measurement debt and failed-request repairs remain open, and site overlap persists. Preserve current legal, security, attribution, measurement, and release gates. After CTO releases capacity and overlap clears, the existing allthingsmasonic.com affiliate CTA request remains the next growth implementation candidate.

CRO handoff: preserve attribution hygiene for all affiliate experiments. Require registered tracking IDs on new affiliate links, keep the $4.92 aggregate commission and 629 aggregate clicks explicitly unattributed, and report clicks, orders, and commission separately. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift from the current aggregate row.

CRO handoff: retain the reviewed microsoft/markitdown opportunity as capacity-gated research only. Fleet use case is converting three owner-approved local source documents into structured Markdown drafts with provenance and parser-error reporting for SEO/content workflows. Evidence is limited to the bounded lab result: MIT license, 195 files, 22 relevant documentation hits, 8/8 checks passed, no dependency installation, and no production access. Remaining risks are parser fidelity, transitive dependencies, maintenance compatibility, and source-use rights. Do not adopt, publish, add dependencies, or change production until CTO and owner-approved prototype review is complete.
